description: This file provides helper functions to create a runtime environment and default account objects for testing purposes in the Zalouser extension. It defines functions for constructing a mock RuntimeEnv and a default ResolvedZalouserAccount with optional overrides.

methods.name: export function createZalouserRuntimeEnv(): RuntimeEnv { createZalouserRuntimeEnv
methods.description: Creates and returns a mock RuntimeEnv object with noop functions for log and error, and a throw-based exit function.

methods.name: export function createDefaultResolvedZalouserAccount( createDefaultResolvedZalouserAccount
methods.description: Returns a default ResolvedZalouserAccount object with optional property overrides.
